name: Crest of Lordaeron
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database. Its experience counts the level 30 build, which halved what dungeon quests give beyond a normal quest.
footerSourceNote: This quest is new in Forever: its text, givers, objectives and rewards come from Wowhead’s Forever database until the beta confirms them. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details: <A weathered crest depicting the mark of Lordaeron. With so few relics left after the kingdom's fall, someone in the Undercity would be very keen to get their hands on this.>
narrative.objectives: Bring the Crest of Lordaeron to Oran Snakewrithe in Undercity.
narrative.offerRewardText: <Oran bites the crest to ensure authenticity.>Well I'll be. A genuine relic of our home. Mostly intact, too. We need to be extra careful with this one.Thank you for your aid in restoring our history, champion. I'll see to it that we take good care of this.
narrative.requestItemsText: What have you got there, champion? A tasty morsel?
